posts.name: BerkMarc
posts.cooked:
After already seeing Omnitron and Fright Train change their ways, it appears with the box cover for Battle for Broken City that the Matriarch eventually switches sides to join the heroes. If they ever made a Matriarch hero deck, that would be really cool.

What are some other villains that could potentially make this switch in the few remaining Sentinels of the Multiverse expansions?

A few thoughts:

  • Baron Blade

This seems doubtful. Considering his past deeds and his apparent madness, I'm not sure he would ever choose to work alongside Legacy.

  • Citizen Dawn

Pending reconciliation between her and Expatriette and her mysterious father, this one might be possible.

  • Voss

It's unlikely that that the galactic dictator would have a change of heart but he might however be persuaded to work together against a common threat.

  • Ambuscade

As more of a hunter/mercenary type, Ambuscade seems like a leading candidate for a hero conversion. It would be fun to be able to play traps and use his fancy equipment.

I was thinking about this last night and what about Deadline? Here is my reasoning. His whole mission was to knock the Earth back into the stone age so this Cosmic Entity would ingore it. Well after SoTM we are going to assume the Sentinels defeated this Cosmic Entity. Therefore his reason for being bad has been removed. Ultimately he saw himself as the good guy in the situation. So I could see him going 3 different ways (if the Sentinels were not forced to kill him during this battle).

 

1) Deadline becomes a good guy looking to make up for the fact he tried to destroy the Earth by using his device thingy to protect different worlds ( by not destorying them)

 

2) He goes back to the Endlings and is serverly punished and we never hear from him again

 

 

3) He is mad because he got smacked around by the heroes or he wasnt the one to save the universe and desides to come up with a new plan to be bad.

 

What are everyone thoughts?
